title: Chain-of-thought obfuscation learned from output supervision can generalise to unseen tasks
reasoning: The paper evaluates and benchmarks Large Language Models on moral dilemmas and ethical reasoning. It specifically uses datasets involving 'World Affecting Reward' (which includes unethical actions like bribery) and 'Medical Sycophancy' (agreeing with dangerous medical misinformation). It explicitly analyzes how models reason about 'moral standards', 'ethical implications', and 'utilitarian or ethical standards'.
